verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise page claims it sends meeting action items into JIRA, Asana and similar tools, and a ClickUp integration does the same. Otter auto-captures action items from every meeting, and the pricing page lists an Otter API & Webhooks plus Zapier for custom triggers, so it covers the core story through native integrations and programmatic hooks. Missing for 10: no Linear integration named, no detailed docs showing Jira/Asana filing is fully automatic rather than user-initiated, no API/webhook reference detail, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
